title: Puzzle 3D React Parity
description: Restore premigration parity for puzzle 3D in the React renderer: GLB coordinate frame, hover/select/gumball/marquee protocol, scene layers (vortices/attractions/target volumes/references/brush preview), and Select/Brush/Fill window engagements.
summary:
Round 2: closed the remaining premigration-parity gaps the user called out — brush/fill suggestions, dead fill slider, missing context menu, and Alt+right-click.

Plugin (puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs, d3 module): added a per-vortex brush-candidate suggestion popup (openVortexSuggestions/closeVortexSuggestions/hoverSuggestion/acceptSuggestion, backed by BrushPreviewState→BrushPlacePayload reuse), a select-then-open context menu covering every selection kind (contextMenuAt, plus a new setTargetVolumeFlag action and vortex/attraction/targetVolume menu branches), fillBuildTick auto-start-at-1 once precompute settles, and fill build progress surfaced in both the engagement slider label and world_interaction_json (fillBuild/suggestionMenu fields). cycleBrushCandidate gained a delta arg and a cycleBrushCandidateBack sibling (keybindings can't carry args) bound to shift+tab.

r3f (infinite/world/r3f/index.tsx): threaded a new onRightPointerDown callback from WorldOrbitGatedProps through the existing (already-built) orbit-suppression hook.

Host (framework/renderer/react/components/world-3d-host.tsx): Alt+right-click over a hovered vortex now opens the suggestion popup instead of orbiting; plain right-click resolves target by priority (vortex → object → reference) via a new pure resolveWorldContextMenuTarget and dispatches contextMenuAt + optimistic popup position; new WorldSuggestionMenu component (hover-to-preview, click-to-place, Escape/outside-click to close, pending/empty status text); 120ms tick pumps for suggestion-building and fill-building; brush ghost now tints with the real hover/select color instead of a hardcoded amber.

ui kit (ui/js/react/index.tsx): shared Slider keeps a local draft value while actively sliding so a slow/controlled round trip can't snap the thumb back mid-drag; focusActiveEngagementInput no longer steals focus from an engagement control.

Tests: 7 new Rust d3 tests (suggestions flow, context-menu-per-kind, target-volume flag, fill auto-start, fill building-progress label) — all rewritten mid-session against a concurrent VcsDocumentApp/DocumentApp architecture migration that replaced the whole prior test suite; 2 new TS tests (resolveWorldContextMenuTarget, shouldAssignWorldOrbitRightMouse). All passing: cargo test 13/13, framework-renderer-react vitest 105/105, infinite-world-r3f vitest 70/70. puzzle-plugin compiles clean native and wasm32-wasip2; wasm bundle rebuilt successfully.

NOT verified: live browser interaction. http://127.0.0.1:6013 (and, as a cross-check, the unrelated lowpoly dev server on :6078) both hang on a blank #root after bootFrameworkOs with zero console output — confirmed via a second, unrelated plugin failing identically that this is a repo-wide dev-environment breakage from the concurrently in-progress OS-VCS-HUB-CQRS-EVENT-SOURCING-REFACTOR ticket (PluginApp/DocumentApp trait redesign + VCS backbone wiring), not a regression from this work. Recommend re-running the live checklist (Alt+right-click popup, brush ghost cycling, context-menu select-then-open, fill slider drag+auto-count-1, `fill 20` command-line regression) once that refactor lands.

Also fixed, in passing, several workspace-wide breakages from that same concurrent refactor that were blocking compilation for everyone (not scoped to this ticket): a stale protocol/plugin/rs workspace-member entry, a wrong relative path in the new mathematical/graph/drawing/rs crate, misplaced //! doc comments in puzzle/3d and puzzle/5d, a missing Clone derive on Puzzle3dScene/Puzzle5dScene, a missing mathematical_geometry import in puzzle/2d's wasm32 build, a module-shadowing import fix for WindowEngagementToggleGroupOption in puzzle-plugin, and a stale ui/react path in infinite/world/r3f's vitest config.
